verdict.rationale: Sentry documents first-party SDKs that it builds and maintains for most popular languages and frameworks. Several pages describe automatic capture of errors and uncaught exceptions: Android, Apple (sentry-cocoa) and Dart for mobile, and .NET and Elixir for backend, where error monitoring starts on Init(). Web frontend support is only implied by the JavaScript source-maps page and the 'drop in the SDK' claim. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of automatic uncaught-error capture in a browser/web frontend SDK, and independent hands-on corroboration of SDK auto-capture.
